Nora (PM): Quick design review 15: deciding between an inline "nudge" (small helper panel in the dashboard header) vs a short inline walkthrough that steps through 3 tasks. Prototype: https://img.mock/nudge-inline-2176.png. Need: recommended default, CTA copy, and keyboard/accessibility checklist. Can we align on approach today?

Bev (Design): Inline nudge is lower friction and preserves context. Walkthrough increases completion but is more disruptive. For copy on nudge CTA options: `Try a sample`, `Launch quickstart`, `Add your first model`. Leaning `Try a sample` for broadness.

Lou (Research): In remote unmoderated sessions, short inline walkthroughs boosted task completion by ~22% but increased perceived interruption. Users who were exploring loved the walkthrough; returning users found it annoying. Suggest: show walkthrough only when workspace activity=0 and time-since-signup < 24h.

Maya (A11y): A11y quick list: 1) ensure nudge has `role=region` and a visible heading. 2) if we do the walkthrough, use `aria-live="assertive"` only for critical step changes; otherwise `polite`. 3) keyboard: provide `Next` and `Back` as buttons (not links) and ensure `Esc` exits and focus returns to the initial trigger. Also, for reduced motion respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Han (Frontend): Implementation notes: we'll implement nudge as a non-modal region with an opt-out dismiss button. For the walkthrough, we can reuse the checklist modal but make it step-focused (stepper). Will add feature flag + rollout. Analytics events: `nudge_shown`, `nudge_cta_click`, `walkthrough_step_view`, `walkthrough_complete`, `nudge_dismiss`. We'll include `variant=nudge|walkthrough`.

Bev (Design): Copy variants to A/B test: A) `Try a sample` B) `Create a demo` C) `Start a guided tour`. A feels neutral, C signals guidance. We should test A vs C. Visual tweak: nudge background should be slightly elevated (surface-2 token) and CTA should be a primary button with 12px radius.

Maya (A11y): Also ensure focus-visible is preserved on primary CTA and that color contrast hits 4.5:1. For walkthrough steps that include code snippets, ensure `pre` blocks are focusable and have `aria-label` like `Step 2 code sample`.

Lou (Research): Metric goals: increase `sample_project_created` by at least 10% for new workspaces without raising `nudge_dismiss_rate` above 40%. We'll run 2-week experiment with 5% rollout then ramp. Collect qualitative feedback via micro-survey after dismiss.

Han (Frontend): I'll open a draft PR with both variants and analytics hooks, plus keyboard handlers and focus management. PR link will be posted when ready. Will respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and add server-side flag for the timing rule (activity=0 & age<24h).

DeployBot: Staging deploy queued (build #4925) 1: includes nudge markup and variant flags for gated rollout.

Nora (PM): Thanks everyone 1: please review PR and leave final thoughts by EOD. If Maya signs off on a11y, we start 5% canary tomorrow. :sparkles:
